Glassworm March 2026 npm and Repository Campaign

Campaign: glassworm-march-2026
Date: 2026-03-03 to 2026-03-18 (15 days)
Actor: Third Party (group)
Impact: credential_theft

Synopsis

The March 2026 Glassworm wave used invisible Unicode, Solana dead drops, and staged install-time loaders to hide credential theft inside official JavaScript packages and repositories. The campaign hit MCP, React Native, and open-source project distribution paths close together, with package releases that looked routine while carrying obfuscated loaders, environment checks, encrypted payload delivery, and crypto or credential theft focused on developer machines and CI runners.
